result_text:
I fixed the three broken default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, so `.htm` generated pages, `<doc>` .NET XML files, `// Generated by` JavaScript files and `build-gradle.js` now match. I also added a regression test. Nothing is committed.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)`, now `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`. The duplicated `html` was the typo.
- **Generated .NET XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`. The old pattern needed a literal `/.xml` path segment, so `MyAssembly.xml` never matched.
- **Generated JavaScript (`// Generated by …`):** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, for the same reason.
- **Gradle JavaScript build files:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so it matches `build-gradle.js` rather than only `.-gradle.js`.

I used `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js` rather than `.*/.*[.]xml`, so that root-level files without a directory component also match.

New test `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java` covers:

- `.htm`, `.html` and `.xhtml` pages recognised by each of the three rules, and a hand-written `.htm` left out.
- A `<doc>` XML file matched, and an ordinary `settings.xml` left out.
- A `// Generated by` JS file matched, and a hand-written `app.js` left out.
- `build-gradle.js` and `build.gradle` matched in build-and-deployment, and `app.js` left out.

Results from `mvn -o`: the new test (4 tests) and `SourceFileFilterTest` pass. The full `codeanalyzer` suite runs 334 tests with 0 failures and 0 errors (3 skipped, which I did not inspect).
